title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.18125v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. translated_title: H-DDCM：用于快速生成式图像与视频压缩的Hadamard码本
translated_abstract: 无需训练的基于扩散模型的压缩方法重新利用扩散模型或流模型的生成先验来压缩数据，而无需将其重新训练为特定任务的编解码器。近期基于码本的方法（如Turbo-DDCM）在超低码率下实现了出色的感知质量，但其对稠密高斯码本的依赖在内存和计算两方面成本高昂，且在现代图像与视频生成器的大潜在维度下扩展性较差。其组合式比特流编码在这种规模下也变得计算繁重。我们提出H-DDCM，这是一个可扩展的生成式压缩框架，用隐式随机化Hadamard字典取代高斯码本。快速Walsh-Hadamard变换能够以O(d log d)的计算量进行投影与重构、以O(d)的内存隐式合成全维字典，而无需实际构建完整的全维字典。我们进一……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出H-DDCM框架，用隐式随机化Hadamard字典替代稠密高斯码本，借助快速Walsh-Hadamard变换将生成式图像与视频压缩的计算复杂度降至O(d log d)、内存降至O(d)，实现可扩展的快速生成式压缩。
en_tdlr: H-DDCM is a scalable generative compression framework that replaces dense Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries, leveraging the fast Walsh-Hadamard transform to achieve O(d log d) compute and O(d) memory for fast image and video compression.
